title: Actual integration on the restricted affine diagonal section
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], a finite-type quasi-compact k-scheme Y, d in N, the smooth ordered affine projection p:A^d_Y to Y [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], an affine open V of Y, and affine diagonal geometry H [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement]. Put B=p inverse V, h=p restricted to V, g=pr1:B times_V B to B, and s=diagonal h. The pasted self-product and open-restriction squares and the affine-tower square present W=B times_V B and A^d_B as limits of the same cospan p, h followed by V inclusion. Define e:W isomorphic to A^d_B as their unique limit comparison; e followed by q equals g. Put r=s followed by e. For any normalized finite twist transport t and P1 family D [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data], take the actual affine counit mate m_B for q over B [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]. Convert its A[0] endpoint to the tensor-unit endpoint using unitChange inverse, pull to r, and precompose inverse canonical Tate pullback. Follow with inverse identity pullback and the canonical section base-change isomorphism for e over id_B. Apply nu_B and inverse sourceComparison. The resulting S:A_B(d)[2d] to C(g,s) is restrictedAffineDiagonalSectionTrace. No DNC, alpha, rho, or arbitrary existence witness occurs in this construction.

proof.text: Paste the self-product pullback with the target-open square and compare it with the affine tower pullback. Mathlib IsPullback.isoIsPullback constructs e and isoIsPullback_hom_snd proves its projection equation.

Use the actual counit transpose over B, the canonical Tate and section base-change comparisons, and the inverse source-site comparison to form the displayed composite. All geometry witnesses are proofs from H or smoothness transported along e.

def restrictedAffineDiagonalSectionTrace (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (affineTraceProjection Y d)]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT) :
    P.diagonalTwist (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme d ⟶
      OrientationRefinement.source P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V H
